scope: Skill Research Batch 309 — Ki Blast Ultimate mechanics/provenance enrichment

records.name: Shocking Death Ball
evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 skill page classifies it as Ki Blast Ultimate, 300 Ki, Expert Mission 14 unlock, and Super 17/Android 17 (DB Super) Customize Partner usage.
The same page documents a 17-hit long-range projectile that deals 30% damage and paralyzes the target.
An independent EM14 guide identifies Shocking Death Ball as a Basic Reward.

records.name: Teleporting Vanishing Ball
evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 skill page classifies it as Ki Blast Ultimate, 300 Ki, PQ62 unlock, and Kid Buu/Kid Buu (Supervillain) usage.
The page documents shield creation, teleportation to the opponent, a 15-hit projectile, knockback, and 30% listed damage.
Independent PQ documentation identifies PQ62 'Frieza's Nightmare Returns!' and lists Teleporting Vanishing Ball among its rewards.

records.name: Super Vanishing Ball
evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 skill page classifies it as Ki Blast Ultimate, 300 Ki, Skill Shop unlock, and Kid Buu/Kid Buu (Supervillain)/Janemba Customize Partner usage.
The page documents an 18-hit long-range projectile with knockback and 40% listed damage.
Independent Dragon Ball documentation corroborates Skill Shop acquisition in Xenoverse 2 and Janemba custom-skill availability.
unresolved: exact damage semantics beyond the cited page

policy: Promote only fields directly supported by current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence. Do not infer drop probabilities or Ultimate-Finish requirements from quest association alone.
